recommendation: Implement patient progress tracking and care coordination for anxiety disorders
implementation_steps: Track patient progress using standardized anxiety assessment tools (e.g., GAD-7)
Facilitate communication between primary care and mental health providers
Ensure follow-through with referrals to specialists when needed
Coordinate stepped care adjustments based on symptom response
Support implementation of collaborative care models for anxiety management
evidence_summary: Care coordinator-led tracking and coordination interventions have demonstrated improvements in anxiety symptom management, treatment adherence, and outcomes when implemented within collaborative care models.
